scenes sc ON sc.id = vb.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = sc.chapter_id WHERE sc.project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ch.id = ch.current_storyboard_revision_id ), shot_counts AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_shots, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(status) = 'QUEUED') AS queued_shots, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(status) = 'GENERATING') AS generating_shots, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(status) = 'VALIDATING') AS validating_shots, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(status) IN ('PASSED', 'SELECTED')) AS passed_shots, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(status) = 'FAILED') AS failed_shots, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(status) = 'MANUAL_REVIEW') AS manual_review_shots, MAX(updated_at) AS shots_updated_at FROM chapter_shots ), selected AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS selected_shots, MAX(st.updated_at) AS selected_updated_at FROM selected_takes st JOIN chapter_shots cs ON cs.id = st.shot_id ), take_marker AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS take_count, MAX(t.updated_at) AS takes_updated_at FROM takes t JOIN chapter_shots cs ON cs.id = t.shot_id ), beat_marker AS ( SELECT MAX(vb.updated_at) AS beats_updated_at, COUNT(vb.id) AS beat_count FROM visual_beats vb JOIN scenes sc ON sc.id = vb.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = sc.chapter_id WHERE sc.project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ch.id = #{chapterId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND sc.storyboard_revision_id = ch.current_storyboard_revision_id ), cue_marker AS ( SELECT MAX(ac.updated_at) AS cues_updated_at, COUNT(ac.id) AS cue_count FROM audio_cues ac JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.story_beat_id = ac.story_beat_id JOIN scenes sc ON sc.id = vb.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = sc.chapter_id WHERE sc.project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ch.id = #{chapterId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND sc.storyboard_revision_id = ch.current_storyboard_revision_id ) SELECT shot_counts.total_shots, shot_counts.queued_shots, shot_counts.generating_shots, shot_counts.validating_shots, shot_counts.passed_shots, shot_counts.failed_shots, shot_counts.manual_review_shots, selected.selected_shots, CONCAT_WS('|', COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM shot_counts.shots_updated_at)::text, '0'), COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM selected.selected_updated_at)::text, '0'), take_marker.take_count, COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM take_marker.takes_updated_at)::text, '0'), beat_marker.beat_count, COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM beat_marker.beats_updated_at)::text, '0'), cue_marker.cue_count, COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM cue_marker.cues_updated_at)::text, '0')) AS change_marker FROM shot_counts, selected, take_marker, beat_marker, cue_marker

SELECT vb.id AS visual_beat_id, sh.generation_strategy, COUNT(*) AS shots FROM shots sh JOIN shot_sequences sq ON sq.id = sh.sequence_id JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.id = sq.visual_beat_id JOIN scenes sc ON sc.id = vb.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = sc.chapter_id WHERE sc.project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ch.id = #{chapterId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND sc.storyboard_revision_id = ch.current_storyboard_revision_id GROUP BY vb.id, sh.generation_strategy
